messages.author: 1b79a49d0816aa89
messages.subject: Goodness-of-fit tests in oSCR?
parts:
Hi all,

Apologies if this has already been answered in this group. I'm wondering if there are any tests for goodness of fit that can be used for oSCR models beyond comparing relative AIC values. Something along the lines of the function secr.test in package secr (https://rdrr.io/cran/secr/man/secr.test.html), that might allow me to assess the fit of the model to the underlying data. So far I've been unable to find any resources for calculating test statistics of this nature specifically for oSCR.fit objects.

Thanks in advance!

Nina

messages.author: 527d9b3ec7deff2d
messages.subject: Re: Goodness-of-fit tests in oSCR?
parts:
Hi Nina,

Unfortunately we have not included this capability into oSCR yet.  Goodness-of-fit is a complicated subject and the approaches to quantifying it properly are computationally expensive.  There are some shortcuts available but their robustness is not well understood.  On the to-do list for sure!
